sn18.10:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kim maññasi Rāhula || || Rūpam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Vedanā || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi nibbindati || saṅkhāresu pi nibbindati || viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti || vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ || kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Dasamaṃ || || Pathamo vaggo || ||
sn18.10:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Cakkhu Rūpañca Viññāṇaṃ || Samphasso Vedanāya ca || || Saññā Sañcetanā Taṇhā || Dhātu Khandhena te dasāti || ||
